title: Determine the top three genres with the most movies rated above 8, and then
question: Determine the top three genres with the most movies rated above 8, and then identify the top four directors who have directed the most films rated above 8 within those genres. List these directors and their respective movie counts.

prediction.sql:
WITH rated AS (
  SELECT g.movie_id, g.genre
  FROM genre g
  JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = g.movie_id
  WHERE r.avg_rating > 8
),
top_genres AS (
  SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS movie_count
  FROM rated
  GROUP BY genre
  ORDER BY movie_count DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
director_counts AS (
  SELECT n.name AS director, COUNT(*) AS movie_count
  FROM rated r
  JOIN top_genres tg ON tg.genre = r.genre
  JOIN director_mapping dm ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
  JOIN names n ON n.id = dm.name_id
  GROUP BY n.name
  ORDER BY movie_count DESC
  LIMIT 4
)
SELECT director, movie_count
FROM director_counts

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH rated AS (
  SELECT g.movie_id, g.genre
  FROM genre g
  JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = g.movie_id
  WHERE r.avg_rating > 8
),
top_genres AS (
  SELECT genre, COUNT(*) c
  FROM rated
  GROUP BY genre
  ORDER BY c DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
directors AS (
  SELECT n.name, COUNT(*) cnt
  FROM rated r
  JOIN top_genres tg ON tg.genre = r.genre
  JOIN director_mapping d ON d.movie_id = r.movie_id
  JOIN names n ON n.id = d.name_id
  GROUP BY n.name
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 4
)
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name || ' (' || cnt || ')', ', ') AS directors
FROM directors

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH rated AS (
  SELECT g.movie_id, g.genre, dm.name_id
  FROM genre g
  JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = g.movie_id AND r.avg_rating > 8
  JOIN director_mapping dm ON dm.movie_id = g.movie_id
),
top_genres AS (
  SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rated
  GROUP BY genre
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
top_directors AS (
  SELECT n.name AS director, COUNT(*) AS movie_count
  FROM rated r
  JOIN top_genres tg ON tg.genre = r.genre
  JOIN names n ON n.id = r.name_id
  GROUP BY n.name
  ORDER BY movie_count DESC
  LIMIT 4
)
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(director || ' (' || movie_count || ')', ', ') AS directors_and_counts
FROM top_directors;
